_: The starting shop (cc_task_e-shop-species-and-ui-notes.md 1.4): what a hero who took the gold instead of the gear can buy before the campaign begins. The SRD 5.2.1 mundane weapons and armor (pp.89-93), potions of healing and the adventuring basics, at the SRD prices in the item files. No arrows, bolts or quivers: ammunition is free (decisions_checklist.md). A campaign replaces it by writing a merchant with this id in its own merchants/ folder. It buys back at the item's own sell percentage, the in-game merchants' rate.
